description: This file declares interfaces, includes necessary headers, and defines constants related to MAP-E tunnel configuration within a WAN Manager project. It appears to be a header file for the WAN Manager's MAP-E features, including function prototypes for configuring, calculating, and resetting MAP-E parameters.

methods.name: WanManager_MAPEConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the MAP-E tunnel based on DHCPv6 parameters received, returning success or failure status.

methods.name: WanManager_CalculateMAPEPsid
methods.description: Calculates the PSID and IPv4 suffix from the provided IPv6 prefix and EA bits.

methods.name: WanManager_MAPE_ResetSyscfgDefaults
methods.description: Resets the MAP-E related syscfg parameters to their default values.
